newsitem.title: USA: Weeks Corp over-allotment option exercise.
newsitem.headline: Weeks Corp over-allotment option exercise.

text.p: Weeks Corp said Friday it announced the exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option with respect to the purchase of 384,200 shares of the Company's Common Stock at $31.50 per share.

The Company previously announced on May 7, 1997, the pricing of a public offering of 3,200,000 shares of Common Stock at $31.50 per share. Goldman Sachs & Co., A.G. Edwards & Sons, Inc., Morgan Stanley & Co. Incorporated and The Robinson-Humphrey Company, Inc., acted as representatives of the underwriters in the offering.
